tools.name: verify_company
tools.description: Start here. Verify a Korean corporation by name, business registration number (10 digits), corporate registration number (13 digits), DART code (8 digits) or stock code (6 digits): does it exist, its National Tax Service status (active / suspended / closed, with the date it was checked), official nu

tools.name: resolve_company
tools.description: Find the Jaryo entity for a Korean company from its name (Korean or English) or an official identifier: business registration number (biz_no, 10 digits), corporate registration number (corp_reg_no, 13 digits), DART corp code (8 digits) or KONEPS vendor id. Returns candidates with confidence. Require

tools.name: match_companies
tools.description: Match up to 1,000 rows of your own company list to official Korean identifiers. Each row is a string or an object/array of cells — a company name and/or a business registration number (10 digits), corporate registration number (13), DART code (8) or stock code (6), in any order. Returns per row: res

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Company profile by Jaryo id: names (ko/en), all identifiers, current profile records (DART overview, procurement vendor profile, tax status, pension headcount) and record counts. Every value carries its source and license. Requires a Jaryo API key.

tools.name: list_company_records
tools.description: Public records attached to a company: procurement awards and contracts, sanctions, DART filings, employment (pension headcount), tax status. Newest first, paginated. Requires a Jaryo API key.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search companies by Korean or English name. Returns up to 20 entities. Requires a Jaryo API key.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Catalog of Korean public data sources Jaryo uses, with license, redistribution status and update cadence. No key needed.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_company" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
